name: Public Health Birth Data: Infant Mortality
attribution: Cook County Department of Public Health

Department.Publishing Department: Cook County Department of Public Health

Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: Source data does not differentiate between gender and sex assigned at birth. For clarity and brevity, metadata descriptions reflect gendered language with the understanding that these descriptions may not accurately reflect all cases.
Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago

columns.name: Place
columns.description: CCDPH jurisdiction refers to all Cook County municipalities except Chicago, Evanston, Skokie, Oak Park, Forest View, Burbank, and (incorporated) Stickney. See the attached district map for more information.

columns.name: Race and Ethnicity
columns.description: Race and ethnicity of mother. "NH" refers to "non-Hispanic". "PI" refers to "Pacific Islander".
